ADNEX Validation Dataset

Source: R/data_adnex.R
adnex_sample.Rd

A de-identified validation dataset (N = 1,500) for use with the ADNEX (Assessment of Different NEoplasias in the adneXa) model, included with evaluatr for use in package examples and vignettes. Provided by Lasai Barrenada, KU Leuven.

Format

An RDS file containing a data frame with 1,500 rows and 33 columns. Key columns are:

age

Numeric. Patient age in years.

ca125

Numeric. Serum CA-125 level (U/mL). Used in the ADNEX-with model only.

max_diam_lesion

Numeric. Maximum diameter of the lesion (mm).

prop_solid

Numeric. Proportion of the lesion that is solid (0-1 scale).

locules_gt_10

Integer. Whether the number of locules exceeds 10 (0 = no, 1 = yes).

papillary_count

Integer. Number of papillary projections (0-4+).

acoustic_shadows

Integer. Presence of acoustic shadows on ultrasound (0 = absent, 1 = present).

ascites

Integer. Presence of ascites (0 = absent, 1 = present).

oncology_center

Integer. Whether the examination was performed at an oncology centre (0 = no, 1 = yes).

outcome5

Integer. Five-category outcome classification: 1 = benign, 2 = borderline, 3 = stage I invasive, 4 = stage II-IV invasive, 5 = secondary metastatic.

pbenw, pborw, pst1w, pst2_4w, pmetaw

Numeric. Reference predictions from the ADNEX-with-CA-125 model (developer-computed, for verification).

pbenwo, pborwo, pst1wo, pst2_4wo, pmetawo

Numeric. Reference predictions from the ADNEX-without-CA-125 model (for verification).

Source

Provided by Lasai Barrenada, Department of Public Health and Primary Care, KU Leuven. De-identified for package distribution.

Details

The dataset is loaded from inst/extdata/adnex_sample.rds using readRDS(). It is stored as an RDS file rather than a lazy-loaded data object because it contains grouped tibble metadata that requires the dplyr package to print correctly.

The ADNEX model is described in: Van Calster B et al. (2014). Evaluating the risk of ovarian cancer before surgery using the ADNEX model to differentiate between benign, borderline, early and advanced stage invasive, and secondary metastatic tumours. BMJ 349: g5920. doi:10.1136/bmj.g5920

See also

secure_model_validation(), the developer guide vignette.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
adnex_path <- system.file("extdata", "adnex_sample.rds",
                          package = "evaluatr")
adnex_data <- readRDS(adnex_path)
dim(adnex_data)
# [1] 1500   33
} # }
